description: This file defines the CancelTaskCommand class, which handles canceling tasks within the Superset application. It manages permissions, task states, and whether to abort or unsubscribe users from tasks, including distributed locking and transaction management.

classes.name: CancelTaskCommand
classes.description: A command class to cancel or unsubscribe from a task, handling permission checks, task state validation, and distributed locking.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the cancel command with distributed locking, returning the updated task.

methods.name: _execute_with_transaction
methods.description: Performs the cancel operation within a transaction, including permission validation and task state updates.

methods.name: _validate_permissions
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to cancel the specified task based on scope and status.

methods.name: _do_cancel
methods.description: Determines whether to abort or unsubscribe from the task based on its properties and user permissions.

methods.name: _do_abort
methods.description: Performs the abort operation on a task, updating its state and logging metrics.

methods.name: _do_unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes the current user from the task's subscribers, if applicable.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Placeholder method for validation, currently does nothing.

methods.name: action_taken
methods.description: Property that indicates whether the task was aborted or unsubscribed.
